name: Cache keepalives and warmers
summary: Tools that send extra turns so the prompt cache doesn't expire while a session sits idle. Rejected: only user reports support them, each keepalive is an extra paid turn, and native idle compaction (Claude Code 2.1.299) covers the costly case of a large session left idle.

evidence.effect: Idle compaction in the terminal for sessions over 200K tokens left idle about 54 minutes

evidence.source: User reports cited in docs/v8/03-admission-ledger.md; not listed in docs/v8/14-sources.md
evidence.effect: Claimed savings from keeping the cache warm; no measurement found

egress.default: extra turns sent to the model provider

revisit: a native regression shown by a paired test
maintenance: Several small third-party tools, not tracked one by one.
